title: Context document
description: The front matter of a scoped context document (schema: context/v1): a README under the layer that adds to its ancestors for the directory it sits in. This schema is the whole contract: the shell tool's allow-list is generated from it and the executable validates against it, so a constraint stated here is the one both halves apply.

id.description: The identity, a lower-case dotted name. It survives a move, so it is the id and not the path that other documents supersede and that projections cite.

providers.description: The providers this document is written for; ["*"] for every one. A name must be projected by the policy.

audience.description: Who the document is for; absent means both.

children.description: What the directories below this one owe. Subtree documents only; the value nearest a directory applies, and a descendant may raise require_contract to true but never lower an inherited true.

exempt.description: Directories inside this document's scope that owe no contract, and nor does anything below them: a subtree this layer carries but does not author, such as an installed package whose integrity is its own manifest's business. Repository-relative. The exemption is declared by the contract that governs the subtree, so it moves with the tree it describes instead of living in a list at the root.

allOf.title: paths belong to scope explicit, and to nothing else
supersedes belongs to composition replace, and to nothing else
children states what descendants owe, which only a subtree document may say
